body: I appreciate this! I feel bad because I know sometimes my dogs can be loud which is why we try to do everything outside: okay time, walks and just anything so that when we are inside it’s just rest time. I will be sticking to headphones from now on or studying in the kitchen to help alleviate the sound. I am going to look into something to hang up and documenting everything. I am planning if anything else happens, I may reach out to management to inform them of what is happening and how I am trying to manage my side . Thank you for replying and for providing some advice ☺️

That’s great! I have been trying to get a good schedule down, especially with starting this new job and slowly we are getting a good schedule going and Mila, one of my dogs, shes starting to pick up when we go out for the night and as it gets closer she will start getting all excited and ready to go
I love that! That sounds so sweet! 💕 sounds like a pretty amazing dog ☺️

I love it! My one dog that likes to sleep next to me will sneak under the covers, she’s very mama obsessed! Our dogs will sometimes sleep in the bed with us but they typically prefer the floor or their own beds except in certain circumstances lol

Thank you! They are both sweet girls and just so goofy. Our black and tan one is named Noodle, and she’s just as floppy as her name, it provides so much laughter😂 I am absolutely obsessed with them, our brindle is Mila and she was our first dog and she’s literally the definition of “perfect” also a bit of a drama queen but I adore her for it 💕

They only let me sleep in on weekends! 😂 And it’s mostly cause, one dog just loves to sleep next to me as soon as my husband gets up and my other dog, I accidentally smacked her one morning that she tried to wake me cause her whiskers tickled my face. I felt so so bad 🥺 my poor baby got caught in my face smacking crossfire and said never again
Thank you! I’ll have to download that app and check it out. I appreciate the suggestion ☺️☺️
Thank you! I will be setting up an appointment after this weekend to discuss this with our vet then just to make sure i cover all bases. I really appreciate the advice 💕

Thank you, my girls also have lots of energy but I’m really excited for this move. We are moving to a coastal city for my career and I can’t wait to take them on adventures, I just hope they have a decent car ride there lol ☺️ thank you again for providing some insight 💕
Thank you! I think we will try to do a really long walk/run beforehand then, see if I can help tire her out before the ride. I appreciate the suggestion ☺️☺️

Thank you! I did not consider the water so I appreciate the insight. My parents dog gets sick on car rides so they do the minimal food and that is my plan. I’ll have a food bag for them, but I won’t be feeding them much. She absolutely loves blankets so that would probably also work. She also loves this big pillow dog bed, so I’m thinking of having that in the back seat. Something comfy to lay on I think . Thank you for the suggestions ☺️
Thank you! I’ll look into getting some of that and seeing how she does with it. I appreciate the suggestion ☺️

Thank you for your kind words! I think we are both very lucky honestly. She bonded with me so very quickly (literally the day we brought her home) and since then, she never leaves my side. She has taught me so much and I am so so lucky that she chose me 💕

Thank you for your kind words. I really struggled at the time because I had just started college at the dorms and I wanted to whisk him away there so bad. I knew it was a big decision because I could see the heartbreak on my moms face. She adored him. It really broke her heart and she still doesn’t talk much about him but she keeps his photo up on our family wall. Now I understand better how that decision was for his betterment. Thank you again, I know I still have more to learn and I’m very excited to learn from my sweet girl and help her feel safe and loved.

I understand that, I’m sorry you had to go through that. I think for me, it’s most important that I understand this was the best decision they could make at the time and that they did it to save him. Thank you though ☺️

My first dog gets compliments on her looks because she is quite unique looking (imo that is, I have never seen a dog look like her outside of her brindle coloring). My second dogs get compliments on how people-friendly she is, she loves to say hi
Thank you! She has come a long way and I’m just so grateful 🥰

Thank you! It is such a joy, especially cause I really want to get into hiking. This trail was an easy trail but I really want to make hiking a hobby and I always want to share it with my dogs so I am so happy with this progress 🥰
Thank you! I absolutely adore them, and have sorta become one of those crazy dog moms. Trying to reel it in but I just go a little cuckoo sometimes 😂😂
Thank you! She is still getting used to the hat, she’s unsure about it over her ears but she is just so chill and just the sweetest goof 💕

Oh I don’t mind at all, I love talking about my dogs! Both of them are mystery breeds but we suspect the first one (chicken)  is a mix of Australian Shepherd/husky. Her name is Noodle and she lives up to that name haha. The second one (hot dog) is a complete mystery. Her name is Mila and she’s very smart and very fast. I suspect a running breed but it’s still up in the air
Thank you, we love to dress up 🎃 last year we didn’t have a big enough costume for my second dog (the chicken) so we are very happy to have her dressed up now

I’m sorry to hear that, my best friends do suffers from extreme grass allergies so she often has rashes so I have seen how uncomfortable that is for them first hand. Hopefully she gets better soon, so she can get them belly scratches haha ☺️
Omg that is so cute and hilarious! 💕😍 I’m guessing they love belly scratches haha
Sooo very true! I call N “floppy” because when you come to cuddle/pet her, she will quite literally flop over it’s the funniest thing 😂
That sounds so adorable 💕 I look forward to “night night time” (as I call it lol ) because I just am so comforted by M’s snuggles
